java_server.upload_multipart_without_boundary: Spring rejects a multipart envelope without a boundary in DispatcherServlet.checkMultipart, before any controller or its @ExceptionHandler is reached: 500. Needs a global @ControllerAdvice or a filter.

kotlin_server_blocking.upload_multipart_without_boundary: Same as java_server: the envelope is rejected before the controller is reached.

kotlin_server_suspend.upload_multipart_without_boundary: Same as java_server: the envelope is rejected before the controller is reached.
